Floorbeat Breaker.name: Floorbeat Breaker
Floorbeat Breaker.description: The user's signature move: both amplified jacks drive a sustained heartbeat into the ground, splitting a narrow strip of pavement beneath one advancing group. Targets fall and take heavy force damage; held back, the user cracks only their footing to stop the charge. The amplifiers must remain connected, and the user's ears bleed after the pulse. Strain: severe.
